purpose: Teach: ジョナサン/ジャカルタ/草津/マイアミ/ロースト/ニーチェ/のび太/ワトソン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがジョナサンの物語を朗読された
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — your father used to read Jonathan's stories aloud to us.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Quiet voice, almost to himself. Pause before 'Jonathan.' Gentle, melancholic pace. Voice fades slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ジャカルタに出張された事もおありだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you went on that business trip to Jakarta too, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gentle redirection. Tender lilt on 'dear.' Light laugh beneath the words, as if she's reminding him kindly. Patient rhythm, like she's heard this before and loves him anyway.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと草津温泉に湯治に行った
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — I went to Kusatsu hot springs with your father for a cure.
lines.style: Another memory surfacing. Voice slightly firmer now, more present in the detail. Still wistful but more grounded. Slight breath before the place name, like it matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、マイアミでの会議に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You attended that conference in Miami, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate interjection, gently persistent. Slight teasing warmth. She's weaving her own memories in, meeting him halfway. Voice bright but not dismissive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがローストチキンを焼かれた
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — your father used to roast chicken so beautifully.
lines.style: Voice softens with the sensory memory. Slight smile in the tone. Slower pace on 'roast chicken.' Wistful exhale. His mind drifting to something ordinary made precious by time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ニーチェの哲学書をご愛読されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You were always so fond of that Nietzsche philosophy book, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate correction, playfully assertive. Knowing warmth. She's gently calling out his pattern while honoring his nostalgia. Slight emphasis on 'Nietzsche,' tender on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お孫様がのび太みたいに眼鏡で可愛かった
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — your grandchild looked so cute in glasses, just like Nobita.
lines.style: Voice lifts slightly with genuine fondness. Warm memory surfacing. Gentle, almost grandfatherly softness on the child's image. Trailing off on 'Nobita' like he's seeing the memory still.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ワトソン医師の役のドラマを愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You did love playing that Watson the doctor role in the drama, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Final warm interjection, softer than before. Tender close. Almost conspiratorial affection. Voice gentles into the endearment. She's settling into this moment with him, letting the past rest.
